calibration_exposure.status: second calibration-visible model-form extension; chronological heldout firewall remains closed

surface_laws_unchanged: La Magna/Garozzo C4F8 film and SiO2 removal

model_extension.allowed_change: replace one shared annular ring radius and width with one radius and width per effective species
model_extension.physical_reason: electron-impact dissociation, heavy fluorocarbon fragmentation, and positive-ion production need not share one radial power-deposition moment; their diffusion lengths and production channels differ
model_extension.unchanged_positive_form: each source remains a normalized nonnegative Gaussian radial moment times the positive exponential Fourier azimuthal modulation
not_allowed: one free source value per measured coordinate

selection_order: fit bounded species radial radii/widths with all azimuthal harmonics zero
select the radial model by leave-one-lot-out calibration
only then add complete azimuthal Fourier orders sequentially under the v2 complexity rule
retain the lowest total model complexity meeting every calibration margin
hash-seal heldout predictions before parsing any heldout outcome

v2_calibration_failure_evidence.algorithm: bounded local least squares with batched finite-difference Jacobian
v2_calibration_failure_evidence.evaluation_scope: shared normalized 89-point calibration map using the first measured waveform; no heldout outcomes
v2_calibration_failure_evidence.status: exploratory bounded failure, not an exhaustive mathematical lower bound
boundary_saturation: F diffusion approximately at lower bound
shared radial width approximately at lower bound
F and film central fractions approximately zero
v2_calibration_failure_evidence.interpretation: v2 materially improves the radial response but misses the 1.8 percent calibration margin; boundary saturation motivates the narrowly scoped species-radial extension

forbidden_shortcuts: opening heldout outcomes before a hash-sealed prediction
changing the Belen or La Magna/Garozzo surface laws
adding per-wafer, per-lot, or target-depth multipliers
changing the coordinate frame or acceptance gates
adding higher radial basis functions unless v3 is first frozen and graded as a calibration failure
